item.title: Hello again
item.description:
This is the umpteenth attempt I’ve made to keep a blog. I’m not going to promise anything, but I’ll try to be honest at least.

This time it’s built with Hugo: posts are plain Markdown files, and the pages are generated automatically when they reach GitHub.

What to expect

Notes about DevOps, the things I’m learning, and probably some of the things I track.
